Name: Visa Permit ID
Description: The surrogate ID for this record. Only available when updating existing records.

Name: Legislation Code
Description: The visa or permit legislation code.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person this visa or permit is for.

Name: Visa Permit Type
Description: The visa or permit type.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person this visa or permit is for.

Name: Effective End Date
Description: The end date of the date-effective changes. If left blank, the effective end date is the end of time by default.

Name: Effective Start Date
Description: The start date of the record or of date-effective changes to the record.

Name: Category
Description: The category of the visa or permit.

Name: Current
Description: Indicates if the visa or permit is current.

Name: Entry Date
Description: The entry date of the person into the country.

Name: Expiration Date
Description: The expiration date of the visa or permit.

Name: Issue Date
Description: The date of issue for the visa or permit.

Name: Issuing Authority
Description: The issuing authority for the visa or permit.

Name: Issuing Country
Description: The issuing country for the visa or permit.

Name: Issuing Location
Description: The issuing location for the visa or permit.

Name: Number
Description: The visa or permit number.

Name: Profession
Description: The profession of the visa or permit holder.

Name: Status
Description: The visa or permit status.

Name: Status Date
Description: The date the status came into effect.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.
